review_time_worktree_observation.note: This current-time observation is separate from each run-start dirty=false and serial-sequence post-run clean facts. Any later documentation/evidence archival is not a run-time source change.

limits: The target is stopped at real syscall-entry before kernel ioctl execution; this proves a real Special blocking task reached the syscall, not an in-kernel active/hung ioctl or physical hardware result.
SET_CONFIGURATION legally releases old interface claims before entry; independent sysfs driver=null/alt0 is expected. Cached current_drivers is not retained-claim evidence.
QEMU ECM CLEAR_HALT actually fails -32 and that errno is preserved. Successful clear-halt/toggle recovery is not demonstrated.
EOF cases close the old USB/IP TCP before release, so no old-wire terminal response is claimed; real ioctl terminal and resource retention/restoration are independently recorded.

Wire evidence is the source-hash-matched strict standalone probe and raw case output. No independent packet capture is present; A completion and UNLINK0 are each checked once without a separate arrival-order assertion.

Guest coordinator/tracer validate UID/caps/PID starttime/FD-node metadata/helper separation; their raw markers and gate identity tuple are preserved. Individual status/stat reads are not separately dumped. Host isolation is scoped to this source-matched dedicated QEMU harness and private socketpair topology.
These six final QEMU scenarios do not replace real G1/G2 hardware, kernel-internal timeout/hang tests, ISO transfer support, arbitrary mixed-composite acceptance or long-duration performance testing.
